patterns_validated.detail: 7-phase milestone completed entirely via /autopilot full-auto with no human oversight gates. All phases passed first attempt.
Phases 04 and 07 executed in parallel via separate code-developer agents, both completed successfully without conflicts.

patterns_validated.concept: guard bun usage in shell hooks
patterns_validated.detail: Hook scripts that use bun -e must guard with command -v bun before runtime detection step. Copilot caught this in PR review.

decisions.detail: luca-observer Next.js dashboard kept intact. SpacetimeDB stripping deferred to v3.2 (#78) because it requires a full rewrite, not just a strip.
Investigation confirmed 2 copies across isolated package boundaries (src/ and packages/luca-framework/) cannot be reduced further without violating module boundary architecture.
